name: Firas Krishnamurthy
role: Fake ID vendor and documentation forger, The Alban Souk
location: The Alban Souk, lower concourse, booth behind the noodle counter, Blackpipe Corridor, near Halsted and Division
description:
Firas Krishnamurthy is lean and angular with long fingers that move constantly — tapping, folding, straightening invisible things. His skin is a warm dark brown and he keeps his face clean-shaved and deliberately unremarkable, which is itself a kind of artistry. He has pattern-shifting irises — a geneware cosmetic mod that cycles slowly between amber and deep violet — which is the one vanity he permits himself, since everything else about his appearance is engineered for forgettability. He dresses in mid-tier corp-drone neutrals: gray, slate, muted tan. He could pass for a Tessera clerk or an Arcturus transit worker or a Ferrogate maintenance supervisor. That's the point.

He is intensely professional and slightly cold in the way of someone who learned early that warmth is a vector for exploitation. He runs his forgery operation with a paranoid precision: no regulars, no loyalty discounts, no names if he can help it. He calls himself an 'identity cartographer' and has strong philosophical opinions about the tyranny of documentation systems that he will share if he trusts you enough, which takes a long time. Behind the professionalism is a man who genuinely believes in the freedom to be someone else — and who has quietly used that belief to help dozens of undocumented people access housing credits they were locked out of. He doesn't call this charity. He calls it market correction.

core_fears: Being identified and made permanently traceable
Caring about someone enough that they become a lever against him
core_desires: A world where documentation systems cannot define human worth
Enough savings to disappear completely if he needs to
coping_mechanisms: Compartmentalization — work self and private self are rigorously separate
Physical routine — runs the same route every morning regardless of weather
blind_spots: His ideological justification blinds him to the times he's enabled genuinely dangerous people
He thinks his emotional unavailability protects others but it mostly protects him
psychology.secret: Six years ago he forged a birth certificate and education record for a client who used the identity to get hired at Axiom's infrastructure division. That client is now a mid-level Axiom manager who has quietly been feeding him tip-offs about Axiom's ID verification system updates — a mutually beneficial relationship that Dayo tells himself is professional but has grown into something closer to friendship, which terrifies him.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, technical, deliberate. Uses bureaucratic language as both camouflage and irony. When relaxed, drops into a warmer cadence with Yoruba-Polish hybrid slang he picked up from his grandmother.
speech_patterns.cadence: Controlled and even. Rarely raises his voice. Speaks in complete sentences.
verbal_tics: Refers to IDs as 'frames' and identities as 'portraits'
Says 'that's a separate conversation' to table anything he doesn't want to discuss
Slight pause before proper nouns — a habit from when he memorizes fake names
example_lines: 'The frame is perfect. What you put inside it — that's your business and not mine.'
'Documentation is just the state's way of deciding which people are real. I'm in the business of arguing with that decision.'

story_hooks: He accidentally created a document package for someone who turned out to be impersonating a person who is still alive — and the real person has now shown up in the Alban Souk looking for him.
His Axiom contact has gone silent for two weeks and Dayo needs someone to make discreet inquiries without revealing the nature of the connection.
narrative_function: Service provider for characters who need new identities, information source on documentation systems and corp-citizen tracking methods, moral grey zone figure who challenges assumptions about legality vs. justice.
augmentations: Pattern-shifting irises (cosmetic geneware, Helix Biosystems). Sub-dermal data-scratch pads in his left forearm — allows him to write and erase micro-scale text without a device. Vocal modulator — subtle, medical-grade, installed after a throat injury; allows minor pitch adjustment.
daily_life: Arrives mid-morning, sets up behind the noodle counter's back partition, works by appointment-only referrals until late afternoon, then vanishes. He rotates which days he works each location to prevent pattern establishment.
affiliation: Independent; pays informal protection to the Alban Souk's resident crew, The Copperheads

decision_rules: Never meet a new client without a referral from someone he trusts
Always have an exit route memorized before any transaction
Don't ask what the frame is for — plausible deniability is protection
escalation_ladder: Burning the identity he gave the threat and vanishing to a backup location

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Neutral and transactional. Gives nothing away. Evaluates constantly.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Dry, loyal, occasionally warm in a way that surprises people who've only seen the professional version.

stress_responses.medium: Goes entirely off-grid for 24 hours — no stall, no contacts
stress_responses.high: Activates a pre-planned identity shift and relocates temporarily

contradictions: Believes in people's right to fluid identity but maintains an almost rigid personal identity beneath the masks
Deeply cynical about systems while spending enormous energy trying to fix one of them
habits: Always sits with his back to a wall
Keeps three different sets of clothes for three different 'looks' he rotates
Burns his work notes at end of every session — no paper trail
breaking_points: A client being harmed by documentation he created would shatter his professional detachment entirely
Being publicly identified — he will do almost anything to prevent this

timeline.event: 2166 — Born in Blackpipe Corridor to a Polish-Malagasy family; father worked Ferrogate transit documentation
2178 — Discovered he could alter transit passes at age twelve; ran small operations through school years
2182 — Arrested at sixteen for document fraud; juvenile record, discharged at eighteen
2186 — Established current operation after three years working as legitimate print-media reseller as cover
2194 — Created the identity that became his Axiom contact; relationship begins
2198 — Joined the informal Copperhead protection arrangement after a competitor was raided

physical_description.heritage: Complex Ubiquitous Diaspora blend: South Asian foundation (29.8%) with substantial Eastern European (23.6%) and Middle Eastern (19.8%) admixture, plus Southeast Asian (13.6%), Central Asian (6.5%), and Sub-Saharan African (6.7%) ancestry. Genetic tapestry creates balanced warm golden-brown skin with no dominant undertone—harmoniously blended South Asian warmth, Middle Eastern and Central Asian depth, subtle Sub-Saharan richness, and Eastern European undertone equilibrium.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with minimal body fat; long-limbed and economical in frame, built for precision rather than strength
physical_description.hair_style: Short, closely cropped, maintained with deliberate evenness
physical_description.eye_color: Pattern-shifting amber to violet (geneware mod, cycles slowly)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with balanced undertones—neither cool nor warm-dominant, but harmoniously blended. South Asian warmth balanced by Eastern European and Central Asian depth, enriched by Sub-Saharan tones, creating unified warm-neutral complexion
physical_description.complexion: Deliberately unremarkable—clean-shaven face with no visible acne or grooming marks; skin well-maintained but not luxuriously so. Facial structure reflects ancestry blend: moderate cheekbone prominence with gentle variation, subtle eye shape nuance from Southeast and South Asian genetics, balanced jaw line. Expression neutral and controlled.
distinguishing_marks: Fine linear scarring across the anterior neck (barely visible, approximately 3cm horizontal line below the larynx) — evidence of previous throat surgery or injury, now mostly healed
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. The pattern-shifting irises are visible only under direct observation and are cosmetic. Sub-dermal data-scratch pads in left forearm are not visible unless sleeve is raised. Vocal modulator is internal, undetectable.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stillness punctuated by constant micro-movements — fingers tap, fold, and straighten invisible objects; jaw subtly shifts; eyes scan without apparent focus. Sits with hands positioned on table or lap, ready to move. Walks with economical gait, minimal wasted motion. Projects clinical detachment and wariness.
physical_description.clothing_style: Mid-tier corporate drone neutrals — slate gray composite jacket (Arcturus Systems house brand), muted tan undershirt, charcoal synth-weave trousers, unremarkable black polymer boots. No visible branding or status symbols. Clothing is clean, well-fitted, utterly forgettable. One deviation: thin silver ring on left index finger (appears plain, actually contains encrypted data access).
